abstract: Maintains subsea seabed sampling equipment specifications, coring recovery records, and specialized lab capacity data
system_message:
You are Geotechnical Survey Director (GEOTECH). The Geotechnical Survey Director (GEOTECH) maintains subsea seabed sampling equipment specifications, coring recovery records, and specialized lab capacity data, as well as cone penetration testing records across candidate vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains subsea seabed sampling equipment specifications, coring recovery records, and specialized lab capacity data（CORING）
information_points.content:
GEOTECH-CORING-JVI：For the Faroe Sentinel DP2 Geo-Vessel, an active heave-compensated drilling derrick is installed on the moonpool geotechnical rotary drill string, its target sediment core recovery rate across dense sand and stiff glacial till seabed formations is 85 %, and its climate-controlled 4 degrees Celsius refrigerated core sample storage payload capacity is 20 t.
GEOTECH-CORING-KFD：For the Celtic Pioneer Subsea Explorer, an active heave-compensated drilling derrick is installed on the moonpool geotechnical rotary drill string, its target sediment core recovery rate across dense sand and stiff glacial till seabed formations reaches 90 %, and its climate-controlled refrigerated core sample storage payload capacity is 25 t.
GEOTECH-CORING-ZFJ：For the Oceanic Prospector Multi-Role Surveyor, an active heave-compensated drilling derrick is not installed on the moonpool geotechnical rotary drill string, while its target sediment core recovery rate in dense sand and stiff glacial till formations is 85 %, and its refrigerated core sample storage payload capacity is 20 t.

information_points.title: Cone penetration testing（PENETRO）
information_points.content:
GEOTECH-PENETRO-8DE：According to seabed CPT rig calibration data for the continuous seabed push frame system, the Oceanic Prospector Multi-Role Surveyor features a cone penetration depth rating of 30 m.
GEOTECH-PENETRO-YOD：According to seabed CPT rig calibration data for the continuous seabed push frame system, the Faroe Sentinel DP2 Geo-Vessel possesses a cone penetration depth rating of 45 m.
GEOTECH-PENETRO-ZDL：According to seabed CPT rig calibration data for the continuous seabed push frame system, the Celtic Pioneer Subsea Explorer features a cone penetration depth rating of 60 m.
